nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Facial Alcohol-Free Toner

avis.texte: This toner is rich and lovely to feel on my face after a good washing. So hydrating!
Awsome product have been using for years. I'd recommend to anyone with sensitive skin.
I use this product every day in my morning routine and I love it! My face feels much better when I use this before applying the rest of my products.
This product has become a staple in my skincare routine. I love how light the feeling of it is!
This is an amazing way to prepare your skin for the next steps. This toner is gentle and feels smooth.
It seems to work well, so I bought it again. It seems to be good for everyday use.
I love your products. I see the smoothness and even tone of my skin. I look at least 10 years younger.
Leaves my skin feeling soft, looking fresh, and I'm acne-free. Will continue to buy.

avis.titre: I use this product to balance my skin before serum
avis.texte: I use this product to balance my skin before serums. It helps.

Honestly at first I was suspicious if I was going to like this toner. Especially since I started using it right after Id had a acne break out… I abs loveeee it. Its so hydrating, has no smell, and helped my skin get back to normal in days. Def recommend. And for my oily girlies like me, dont worry its super balancing. It has no oily or greasy feel to it. Its been great with + without makeup.
I use the toner as a daily base after the Ultra Facial Cleanser. It leaves my face feeling hydrated, fresh and smooth.
Great for everyday use. I rotate it with the Milky Peel toner depending on the day. Very gentle.
It had Bad smell due to the ingredient gone bad. It was an old cosmetic material smell .
Moisturizes and does not strip skin. Silky texture. I really enjoy this toner
Love this toner, it's more like a lotion and doesn't contain alchohol so no drying of skin.

I'm 42 with combo/dry thats also a bit sensitive skin. I've used every toner from the drug store to department store for decades and they all ended up too either too harsh, overly drying, or did nothing at all. iv used the ordinary 7% glycolic acid and when my skin needs some good intensive exfoliating ( which is a great, inexpensive product) but that's once maybe twice a month and at night only! the rest of the year I use this toner! its reduced my redness significantly imo ! doesn't burn / sting or leave me feeling stripped! P's. a little goes along way and be careful when applying to cotton pad it can come out fast causing wasted products !

The outcome is good, but I know now why I changed products awhile ago. It doesn't soak into the cotton pad, it rolls off, onto the counter, Floor etc. Good product, just wish it was less messy to use.

I have been using Kiehl's for over 15 years and they keep changing the toner ingredients. It used to have the appearance of H2O and was in a spray bottle now it's like a thick cream. Bring back the spray clear toner please!

avis.titre: Good for sensitive skin, hydrating af
avis.texte: I LOVE this toner. I've been using it since 2016 and nothing compares. I have acne prone, eczema prone, sensitive skin. This really sinks into my skin. I notice a difference in my skin when I run out. Kiehl's please release a travel size
I've noticed as I get older my skin is getting drier. This toner doesn't sting on my face, but still feels clean and refreshed afterwards.
I use this toner for seasons that I feel I need an extra moisture lock. It's not scented and doesn't cause irritation. It simply works.

I have very dry, somewhat sensitive skin. This toner is gentle and excellent for everyday use. I have been using it with other KIEHL'S products including the oil cleanser, and my skin is very happy!!!

This is my second time purchasing this toner- I pair it with the ultra facial moisturizer. It feels great on my skin and helps me remove any extra makeup leaving my skin clean and ready to be moisturized. It's soothing and not irritating. Great product

This product is average at best. I really saw no improvement incorporating this into my daily skincare routine. Didn't seem to do anything. At least it was fragrance free and didn't irritate my skin in any way.
Love it! A little goes a long way and the bottle size and price make for a great deal on a great product.
i use it after i shower everyday and then use the facial cream afterwards
A favorite. This toner adds moisture to my skin and makes it feels smooth and soft.
i have only used this for a few weeks but i implemented this product into my daily routine and it definitely has improved the texture of my skin and leaves it feeling soft
It did not work for me! After the use my skin was dry and red. I wish I tried a sample before buying a full-size product.
This toner isn't as liquidity as other toner's but it does make my skin feel clean and fresh.
Had a sample and loved it so much I ordered a full bottle. Leaves skin feeling clean and helps makeup stay on longer.
This toner is so moisturizing my skin feels soft, moisturize and conditioned. I'm glad I purchased this. I have oily to normal skin so sometimes I need some moisture and this doesn't strip my face.
Highly toxic ingredients. Was rated 8/10 in toxicity by Talk Dirty. Super disappointed.
I have dry skin and this is the best thing for me! I have less skin irritation since I started using this and it is very comfortable to use. It is indispensable for me.
I love this toner, but I dropped a star because my product arrived damaged. I purchased 2 toners & the top was broken off of one container. I didn't spill out, so I kept it.

avis.titre: Good price for the large bottle
avis.texte: It's okay but I don't like the smell and texture I will finish mine and order the other one

Excellent toner! After cleansing, I apply this toner as part of my skincare routine via cotton pad. This toner does a great job at removing debris that cleansing may not pick up. After applying, my skin feels refreshed and ready for the rest of my skincare routine. If you're looking for a light, simple, no-frills toner then this is the one to get!
I use this everyday in my skincare routine, followed by the ultra facial moisturizer and sunscreen.
Great first step before applying serum and moisturizer. Have used the Kiehl's cucumber toner for years. The milky Ultra Toner is rich, smooth and soothing.
Wonderful toner but unfortunately I reacted to one of the ingredients and I am unable to use.
One of my favorites. When I apply the toner after shaving and washing my face, it feels cool an soft.

Overall good toner, I use it every morning and night after cleaning my skin and put on moisturizer right after. Was recommended this by this girl with beautiful clear skin so I had to buy it. Honestly one of my greatest purchase and will continue to use. I recommend using their moisturizer with this, I don't think cleanser matters but I use Sunday Riley.

I LOVE all of my Kiehl's products. I bought this toner specifically for traveling to the Middle East because it doesn't contain alcohol. However, it leaks everywhere in my Ziploc bags and now I can't travel with it because I end up wasting product.

Feels great on the skin. Love that it doesn't immediately soak into my cotton facial pad, but rather sits on top. No breakouts or burning, just very gentle. Don't know if it makes a difference or not, I just like using it cause it makes me feel special and I have no idea why.
I bought 4 products here, never come back again, and destroy my face
My go to toner. I have used this toner for 6 years. I have used other Kiehls toners but this one, by far, is my favorite. My skin never feels dried out.

I am IN LOVE with this milky toner!! My face is so sensitive to products & I was nervous about trying this. In just 3 days I could see a difference! The scent is light & my skin feels so moisturized when I use it! I don't use a cotton pad. Instead, after cleansing my face I pour a dime sized amount into the palm of my hand & spead it all over my face. It doesn't irritate ANYTHING. Not even the eye area! 2 months ago I decided to add the Ultra Cleanser & Moisturizer. I'm not kidding when I say people have asked me if I've had resurfacing done. My fine lines have diminished SO much & my skin glows! I will never use another brand again. This is THE holy grail!

avis.titre: Facial Toner is my best friend.
avis.texte: The facial toner does take a week and a half to see results BUT I could definitely tell the product is working in the first three days. I love the scent and there's enough product to go around the face with 1.5 cotton pad! I love this product.
This product is amazing! Particularly when paired with Kiehl's Ultra Facial Cleanser and Ultra Facial Cream.

I have been using this toner for years because it is so good for my skin. It is not oily nor is it drying. It is gentle and effective. Kiehls - do not change this formula! You changed the Eye Alert gel by mixing it with another product and it's never been the same. I'm still hoping you'll go back to this original formula for the Eye Alert.
This product is so refreshing on a hot day! I soak a cotton ball with the toner and dab on my face and behind my ears.

avis.titre: OMG They Actually Had What I Needed In Stock!
avis.texte: Shocking but they had the product I wanted in stock, in the large size, available for pickup at the store! The stars must have aligned because Kiehl's is usually out of their most popular products. Either way, I'll take the win and won't be out of toner for quite some time!
I use it every morning and night after cleansing. It's very gentle & leaves my skin feeling refreshed.
It was already used and dirty. It wasn't even sealed. Looks like it was used for costumers to try at the one of the stores. I really don't understand how could this happened.

Wanted a morning toner that wasn't stripping. This is a nice, light formula that primes my face in the AM. I use the milk toner at night when I need some extra exfoliation. I feel like my skin has better hydration and oil production during the day with this.
I'll be completely honest-- I have no idea if this is "working" but it feels good on my skin! Much gentler on my skin than other toners I have used.

Switched products due to new reactivity. My skin is aging and mostly normal. I use this along with the ultra cleanser, vitamin C serum, and ultra moisturizer. Really like how gentle this has been yet effective.
Not sure if it's a particular issue with my order, but the toner has a weird smell (like fishy smell). I don't want to use it at all.
Love this toner. I have used this for over 30 years and is a great product made for sensitive skin.
The Facial Toner I bought has been stored for more than THREE YEARS!

avis.titre: Ultra facial toner is the best product ever!
avis.texte: I have been using this product since it's inception. It is non drying and provides a clean and smooth surface to accept moisturizer.

avis.titre: Good product but watch for online double orders.
avis.texte: Added one-time to auto-order, then the auto-order was sent as well.
Doesn't dry out my skin, or leave it feeling tight. Picks up any residue from the cleanser, and it's alcohol free.

I can't get enough of this toner. Very balancing and moisturizing, but it also removes that last bit of impurities left after cleansing. I usually only have to buy one or two bottles a year, using a quarter sized amount 1-2x/day on a cotton round. This will likely be a lifetime staple in my routine.

avis.titre: Given a product that is going to expire in 2 month
avis.texte: The reason why I ordered on your official web is that I want to get a newly produced one. I received the product on Nov. 24 2021 and it expires on Jan.1 2022. That's what you did to my Thanksgiving! Thank you!
I hadn't used toner for years and just decided to try it again. I definitely see an improvement to my skin. More even tone, and softer!!

I have extemely oily skin. Even so, during the winter, I need an extra boost of hydration. This toner is perfect. It reminds me of a very thin milk. The liquid is not thick at all, and I just pat it on my face to help push it in my pores. I use 2-3 different toners on my face each time, and the products vary depending on the season. I use this during the fall and winter months. I highly recommend this if you want a little boost of moisture. Did not break me out and went beautifully with my other skincare products and under my make-up.

The consistency is a little surprising, it is thick and lotion-y so wetting the cotton pad is a bit trickier than a traditional toner, but the feel is wonderful. My dry winter skin loved the moisture. I can see using this all winter into spring and then switching back to a more traditional toner when the air is not as dry.

I bought this toner at ulta because there was skin specialist that promised it would help my really dry skin.... well it didnt . This was one of the products that broke me out. It was so bad I was embarrassed to leave my house. If your looking for a good toner id suggest you try another brand their eye cream also burned my skin

I have sensitive, acne prone skin. I was trying out the First Aid beauty hydrating oats toner and for some reason it stung slightly every time i used it. I tried this, and no stinging feeling. My face feels super soft and plump after applying this. This will definitely be a new staple.

avis.titre: Great product! Terrible packaging for travel!
avis.texte: I LOVE this toner! It's super hydrating and does exactly what it says! I sometimes do multiple layers when my skin needs some TLC. My only gripe is that the travel size bottle always leaks when I take it on a plane...always! This last trip was the worse I've seen it leak out, thank goodness I decided to put it in its own baggie!
I have oily skin and this really balanced it out. The toner took away those annoying little bumps I had on my face and improved the texture! love it so much
It's alright and not a fan of this products ingredients order. I like the FAB toner better.
Toner is important in skin care routine. Finding one that doesn't kill dry skin is not easy. I love this formula. Its my new gold standard.

Ok. In no way am I saying this has cured my skin bc I still do have acne. BUT. The texture on my forehead became horrible over the past few weeks with lots of little bumps. Nothing was working for me and it was really frustrating. I have been using for about a week and most of them have gone away and my skin looks a lot more fresh and glowy since I started using it. Will for sure continue using it!
It's ok. I like other toners better. I wish Phenoxyethanol had been lower on the list. ATM I'm only using it on my body.
Made my skin worse. If you have combo to oily skin or sensitive skin just beware.

avis.titre: Great value for money and good product
avis.texte: Helps a lot with texture! I have combo skin and was looking for something gentle. This has evened out my skin tone well and you get a lot in the bottle!

I bought this toner because I wanted something gentle to use on my skin. It does a great job taking everything off after I cleanse, and it leaves the skin feeling super soft and not dried out like other toners I've used.
I was shocked to find that this product has a milky consistency. I do not feel clean after using this product. I don't understand it. What's the point of this???

I am 30. I didn't develop acne till my mid 20's. My skin tends to be oily in the summer and dry in the winter. It is sensitive and prone to hormonal break outs. I have a good bit of acne scarring on my cheaks and a few large pores around and on my nose. My forehead will occasionally break out when I dont drink enough water/ when I eat unhealthy foods. The Kiehl's line has been a real answer to the issues I deal with - specifically this toner! I highly recommend this toner because it controls sebum production, hydrates and evens texture. At night, I like to remove my make up, tone and moisturise. In the morning I like to wash my face with water, use this toner and moisturise. I find that my face will get simultaneously dry and oily (with a lot of sebum production) if I use a cleanser in the moring... but I also can't just add moisturiser to my face ( in the morning) because it makes make up application complicated and cakey. This toner feels more like a moisturiser which is what I need! I am so happy:) A little goes a LONG way and the price for the size of this product is Amazing!

I never really believed in using toner because I legit thought it was literally water that people charge you for. But this toner is different and it is such a great value for what it has and what it does.

I was looking for a new toner and this one had great reviews so I decided to try, I really like it! I have very sensitive red skin and I was looking for something fragrance and alcohol free. This toner makes my skin feel very soft and it's nice and calming too

Coming from someone with sensitive skin, this toner is great! Since my skin has cleared, I'm very weary about using any new products, however, I received a sample of this toner and worked it into my routine for a week and I have been super happy with the results. The toner is very light and doesn't leave a film afterwards. I then apply my Ultra Facial Moisturizer and my skin looks very smooth, pores minimized and no irritation. I wasn't using any toner before and now I believe it to be essential to my skincare routine.
I rarely write reviews, but I had to for this toner. I freaking LOVE this stuff, great for dry and sensitive skin!
Soooo good. Wish it was cheaper for the amount you get though

I've never had any luck with toners... but with this one I knew it was a winner from the first night I applied it. As I'm writing this, it's the next morning AFTER 1 USE and my face looks brighter, feels softer, and my skin tone looks more even than it has been in a long time. All the reviews are spot on.
This is the first time using this product but I don't know why it's smell bad.
Cleans without leaving your face greasy, instantly noticeable brighter & happier skin tone! I received this as a sample in my last order & IMMEDIATELY ordered it!

avis.titre: Like how the toner make my skin feel
avis.texte: Been using about two weeks like how it make my skin feel and the texture is not running and I like that it don?t have a strong smell. The price is nice too for how big the bottle is.

I was at first scared about this toner since it does have a milky consistency and I have very oily acne-prone skin. However, this sinks right into the skin and doesn't leave a residue and gives the right amount of hydration with only using a small amount of it. My skin looks so GOOD after just using it a couple of times! I rarely have breakouts now and my skin texture has definitely improved thanks to this toner. It's definitely worth the money.

The best toner ever. Very hydrating and do not irritate skin at all. I have very sensitive skin and this is the perfect toner I am looking for. I have been using this for almost 3 years. Even at the time that I had acne, this was still very hydrating and calming to my skin. Works amazing every time. I will be continue using this!

avis.titre: Great for home, but do not take on a plane.
avis.texte: It's a really nice formula that never dried out or irritated my skin. Really helped my acne and skin tone. However, the bottle is not made for travel. Bought it at an airport in a travel size, but once opened it could not be stopped from leaking everywhere. Think I lost half of the product through spill.

Not raving about this product but it does the job while traveling. However, packaging is not made for traveling at all. Three trips, three spills. Saran wrap and aluminum foil around the top before screwing the top back on did not help. Truly disappointed at losing half the product.

I love this toner primarily because it doesn't feel harsh and it doesn't dry out my skin. It's also a big bottle and I only need 5-6 drips onto my hand to completely cover my face, so it's going to last me forever! I think some Kiehl's products are overpriced for the amount you get, but that's definitely not the case with this product!

I use this daily and have been for a year. It has really changed the texture and overall appearance of my face and seems to set the stage for applying serum and moisturizer. I'm hooked. I'm 38 and have tried so many toners that dried my face out however this does not!

I thought that I was doomed to have a pimple or two every month until menopause. It didn't bother me too much, but it was annoying. I got a sample of this toner and suddenly I went 8 weeks without a zit. I get pimples much less frequently now, they are smaller, and they only last 2-3 days (compared with 1-2+ weeks before). I will say, it does dry out my cheeks a little bit, but I don't get acne there anyway so I just skip that part of my face.

I don't write reviews. This is my very first one and it is SO WORTH IT. I have about average skin that breaks out here and there. But ever since using this stuff with my philosophy routine IT HAS CHANGED MY SKIN DRAMATICALLY. My face is so bouncy and clean. My break outs are like NEVER now. It's amazing.

Although this toner can be used all year it really saves my skin during dry winter months. Using this before applying the Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado in the morning and the Midnight Recovery Eye treatment at night just seems to make them absorb even better. I follow up with the Ultra Facial Moisturizer and my skin is protected from harsh winter dryness. I love it so much I have been using it for years and years, I really love this product.

Foolishly I purchased the travel size toner on 4 ocassions thinking I received a faulty one each time. After my most recent trip I realized that Kiehls has not securely sealed the toner bottle so it does NOT leak. The first several times I opened my travel bag and there was leaked toner everywhere! Clearly I thought it was me or that I bought a defective product. After wasting my money on what is now a 4th one I realized the blame lies with Kiehls. TOTAL waste of money as the toner has leaked everytime I've traveled with it. What a mess! I'm so disappointed in their inablity to properly package the toner to prevent leakage.
it took less than a month for me to see a difference in my skin

i personally didn't purchase the product myself but my best friend gave me her bottle of this toner that she didn't want after it broke her out. obviously i was hesitant because it broke her out but her skin is different from mine and i really needed a new toner but had no money at the time, so i took it. i've been using it everyday, twice a day with a cotton round after washing my face and ... it works. it really does take off excess dirt/makeup/residue from your face that your facial cleanser may not take off. i have sensitive/combo skin and this product feels so nice on my skin. it's more of a milky texture than your usual liquid toner, which i think is pretty cool. my texture on my forehead has disappeared and there are times when i don't drink water which quickly affects my forehead texture but since this toner, they haven't resurfaced. lastly i absolutely love that this product does not dry out my skin like several other toners i have tried. i will be continuing to use this toner after i run out of my current bottle.

I really love this toner. Every calming and hydrating. Super nice for whatever treatment I am going to put on afterwards. Definitely recommend for those with sensitive skin and that needs to be calmed down.

I really wanted to love this. I wanted to love this so much that I went and purchased the full size of it when the travel size was already burning my skin to the ground. I didn't even get to use this toner for two weeks. After the first week of consistent use, my face began to break out into pimples along my chin & cheeks and my eczema flared up terribly. I do not have acne prone skin. At all. My face is dry & eczema prone. I stopped using this toner. It hasn't even been a full week and my skin is almost back to normal. The only thing I did was stop using this toner. This is disappointing because everything else from this line is amazing.

I've been trying so many toners trying to find one that I like and I finally found one that does it all! I transferred mine into a spray bottle, so I spray it a bit onto my face, then I spray some on my fingertips and pat it all in. I love that it is milky and thick, it makes it feel luxurious and like a serum. It immediately hydrates my skin, so much that I could go without a moisturizer if I wanted to (which no one should lol). I've only been using it for about 4 days and the only thing it hasn't given me immediate results on is my acne. It hasn't made me break out even more, but it hasn't cleared yet. Which is totally okay it hasn't been long. The ingredient list is amazing too, its one of their best toners and also the cheapest! If you are thinking about getting this, buy it!!!

This is amazing! This is one of the first toners I've used that you use your fingers instead of a cotton pad. I love it! The absolute dream team with the facial cleanser. Gives me soft skin and helps with active acne and hyperpigmentation. Used both of them for a little over a month.

I *think* this product really works. Full disclosure, a few things happened around the time I began using this. I got pregnant, obv. cut out alcohol, switched from liquid foundation back to BM powder, and began using the Kiehl's Blue Cleanser, Ultra Toner, and Ultra Face Cream all at the same time. I also use Dead Sea salt water under the toner. Which of these did the trick, I may not know for sure. But for the first time in 4 YEARS my skin is really clearing up. TERRIBLE cystic acne showed up in 2015 at 27 years old and I swear, nothing worked - not long term. Not getting off birth control, not getting on birth control, not major elimination diets of diary or gluten or sugar, but FINALLY it's greatly improved. I hope it continues to do so and if it does, even beyond pregnancy, I'll be a Kiehl's customer for life.

I really love this toner! It's super soothing and calms my sensitive skin with rosacea. It does not make my combo skin oily at all. I apply it with just my hands. When on a cotton ball or pad I feel like it just soaks right up and I don't get any product onto my face.

avis.titre: have nothing feeling about this product
avis.texte: I have started use Kiehls since 2007. I don't think this toner has any function as a skincare product. it is just milky water

I have super dry skin and most toners tend to immediately dry it out and make it feel tight. After a lot of research I bought the Kiehl's toner and I am never going back! First off, you only need about three drops of it to cover your entire face - and then maybe another one to cover your neck. A little definitely goes a long way, making it well worth the price. Secondly, my skin feels brighter and has been breakout free since I started using it. I love the little bit of moisture it adds to my skincare routine. I would recommend you pair this with another moisturizer/sunscreen as well, if you have dry skin like me.
